description:
Cast Empowered Autogenerator by paying its mana cost.
When Empowered Autogenerator enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Empowered Autogenerator that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Empowered Autogenerator token by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Empowered Autogenerator and then adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Empowered Autogenerator token.
Repeat from step 3.
